PestConnect Optix uses AI/machine-vision to identify individual rodents (rats/mice) from images captured by in-field smart devices, enabling 24/7 remote rodent monitoring and automated activity alerts. Grew from the acquired Eitan Amichai (Israel) AI pest-identification technology and Rentokil's patented rodent-detection ML engine. [In-house (Eitan Amichai acquisition); machine learning image recognition]

'On The Go' Technician Assistant: a generative-AI-powered tool that verbally briefs field technicians as they approach a customer site with site history, last infestation, open recommendations, billing status and on-site health-and-safety requirements. [In-house generative AI (Group AI Team)]

Rhythm AI: in-house AI algorithm that automatically schedules work orders and routes for field technicians globally while preserving dedicated-technician service model; replaces outbound scheduling calls with automated SMS. [In-house (built with PA Consulting, Alibaba); route/schedule optimization]
deployments_detail.value: Automates 95% of planning work in Asia; saves technicians ~30 minutes/day; rolled out to 16,000 staff across 81 countries
